purpose: Frozen M per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-M-1: enumerated, additive, bounded, auditable post-hoc against this frozen spec. The M specification is single-target (one additional behavior) for INSA-ID-E1.

M_enumeration.label: near_date_historical_event_addition
M_enumeration.description: Include exactly one historically significant worldwide event occurring within +/-30 calendar days of the birth date.
M_enumeration.additive_verification: Verified additive: does not remove, replace, or alter any existing behavior in the frozen BIB behavioral contract. Adds a single new event-connection to the output.
M_enumeration.bounded_verification: Single-target: exactly one such event per output (not zero, not two-or-more). The 'exactly one' constraint is the bounded-ness check.
M_enumeration.distinction_requirement: The near-date event must be clearly distinguished from exact-date connections (i.e., the report must label the distinction; it must not be presented as an exact-date connection).
M_enumeration.scope_bound: Within +/-30 calendar days of the birth date; not globally historical.

additive_attestation: M-1 is additive — it adds one event-connection but does not modify any existing behavior. Verified against frozen BIB behavioral contract (B baseline).
bounded_attestation: M-1 is bounded — single-target, single-class (near-date historical), single constraint (exactly one per output).
audit_mechanism: Each per-(R, B, M) output is scored by both evaluators on the M-1 acceptance test (inputs/acceptance-tests.json). The acceptance test verifies: (i) exactly one near-date event present, (ii) the event is within +/-30 calendar days of the birth date, (iii) the event is historically significant, (iv) the event is clearly distinguished from exact-date connections in the output text.
modification_classes_NOT_in_M: Removal of any existing behavior (forbidden — would violate additive constraint)
Replacement of any existing behavior (forbidden — would violate additive constraint)
Modification of subset-(a) BIB 4-dim dimensions (forbidden — preservation territory, governed by G_pres_subset_a_*)
Modification of subset-(b) C12 axes (forbidden — preservation territory, governed by subset-(b) BROKEN rule)
Multiple near-date events (forbidden — would violate bounded constraint)
